companies.title: Company career pages
companies.description: Career pages to scrape, one per line. Supported: Greenhouse (https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb), Lever (https://jobs.lever.co/palantir), Ashby (https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp), Workable (https://apply.workable.com/huggingface), Recruitee (https://bunq.recruitee.com), SmartRecruiters (https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/BoschGroup) and Workday (https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite). The short form ats:slug also works, e.g. greenhouse:airbnb.

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Return the full job description as HTML and plain text. Workable, SmartRecruiters and Workday need one extra request per job for it, so turning this off makes those runs faster.

keywords.title: Title keywords
keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. engineer, sales. Leave empty to keep every job.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location contains at least one of these texts (case-insensitive), e.g. New York, Germany, Remote. Two-letter country codes such as US also match the country field.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs marked as remote by the ATS or with Remote in the location.

onlyNewSinceDays.title: Posted within (days)
onlyNewSinceDays.description: Keep only jobs published in the last N days. 0 keeps all jobs. Jobs without a publication date are kept.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Maximum number of jobs to return for each career page. 0 means no limit.

maxItems.title: Max jobs in total
maxItems.description: Maximum number of jobs to return in the whole run. You pay only for jobs that are saved.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. The ATS APIs work without a proxy.
